property_summary: For every call to transfer, if the _tos array is empty then the reference contract reverts (refuses empty recipient lists), but the mutant allowing _tos.length >= 0 permits empty lists and thus returns true without making any calls — the rule: transfer MUST revert when _tos.length == 0; the mutant violates this for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to require _tos.length >= 0 (always true), removing the guard against empty _tos so function can proceed and return true even when _tos is empty.
